item.title: China posts record trade surplus as Trump strains allies
item.description: China posted a record $1.2T trade surplus in 2025 as President Trump’s policies strained U.S. alliances and pushed partners toward Beijing.

item.title: Hudson Tunnel Project may halt construction amid funding freeze
item.description: Construction on the $16B Hudson River rail tunnel could pause Feb. 6 unless President Trump lifts a funding freeze, threatening thousands of jobs.

item.title: Federal Reserve holds interest rates steady amid inflation
item.description: The Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, citing elevated inflation and solid growth, while offering little guidance on when rate cuts may resume.

item.title: Hedging of dollars for clients could test bank capacity
item.description: Investors rushing to protect their U.S. assets against dollar depreciation could test banks’ ability to meet demand for hedging, said a senior trader at UBS, one of the world’s top currency dealers.

item.title: Milwaukee seeks developer to save historic building
item.description: Milwaukee is making a final push to find a developer to preserve the historic Hummel/Uihlein Building in Harambee before demolition.

item.title: Three health care groups renew leases in metro
item.description: Three health care organizations have renewed leases for medical office spaces totaling 80,000 square feet in the Twin Cities metro, according to a press release from Forte Real Estate Partners, who arranged the leases.

item.title: Roseville joins calls for eviction moratorium
item.description: A third city has passed a resolution asking Gov. Tim Walz to enact an eviction moratorium to prevent vulnerable residents from being evicted during Operation Metro Surge.

item.title: Oppidan plans 195-unit senior living campus in Maple Grove
item.description: Oppidan Investment Company is proposing a 195-unit senior living campus in Maple Grove’s 105th Avenue Growth Area.

item.title: Oakdale advances $28M city hall, police expansion plan
item.description: Oakdale is moving ahead with a $28 million project to remodel city hall and expand police facilities, adding space and modernizing services.

item.title: Minnesota leads nation in construction job losses in December
item.description: Minnesota lost 9,900 construction jobs in December, the biggest decline in the U.S., as economists cite funding delays and possible immigration enforcement impacts.
